title: API plans and access
snippet:
The API is self-serve on every Consensus plan. Your plan sets how many calls you get each month, how many papers each request can return, and which features you can use.
##
​
Get a key
1
Open the dashboard
Sign in to Consensus and go to [consensus.app/api-mcp](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/), or click your profile icon and choose **API & MCP Dashboard**.
2
Create a key
Click **Create API key**, name it, and copy it. If you already have a key, open **Keys and clients** and click **New key**. The full key is shown once.
3
Send it on every request
Pass the key in the `x-api-key` header. Requests without a valid key return `401`.
##
​
What each plan includes
| | Free | Pro | Teams | Deep | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Included calls per month | 30 | 500 | 500 | 2,000 | Custom |
| Max calls with additional usage | 30 | 1,000 | 1,000 | 10,000 | Custom |
| Max papers per request (`page_size`) | 20 | 300 | 300 | 750 | 1,000 |
| Pagination past the first page | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| [Full-text excerpts](/api-full-text) | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| [Complete text](/api-full-text#complete-text) of open-access papers** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Institutional full-text links (`institutional_access_url`)* | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Citations and references (beta)*** | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Rate limit | 1 request/second | 1 request/second | 1 request/second | 1 request/second | Custom |
* Returned on the first 50 search results and on [Thread](/api-quickstart-threads) citations when you’ve selected your institution in Consensus settings. An organization key uses the institution of the person who created it. ** `GET /v1/papers/full_text`, at 1 credit per paper returned. *** `GET /v1beta/papers/citations` and `GET /v1beta/papers/references`, at 1 credit per 100 papers returned. Both are in beta, so their request and response schemas may change in the coming days. Every plan can use every search filter. Compare plans at [consensus.app/pricing](https://consensus.app/pricing).

title: Subscription Plans
snippet:
The Enterprise plan provides services for large-scale research needs.
- **Features:**
- All Team features
- Greater volume discounts
- Manage thousands of users
- Early access to features in development
- All user data is secure and private
- Centralized billing & account management
- Development partner program (for organizations with 500+ users)
- Library integrations
- Product training and search optimization sessions for users
- 500 included [API & MCP](https://consensus.app/api-mcp/) calls per user, per month

title: Connection reference
snippet:
Two options. For a shared, server-side gateway credential, use an API key.
- API key (recommended for gateways)
- OAuth 2.0 (per-user)
A single opaque credential sent as a bearer token:
```
Authorization: Bearer ak_live_...
```
It lives entirely server-side, involves no user redirect and no token refresh, and maps to your Enterprise tier. Generate one from your Consensus account: profile icon → **API & MCP Dashboard** → **Keys and clients** → **New key**. The full key is shown once.Treat it like a password: keep it out of client-side code, public repositories, and screenshots.
Authorization-code flow only. There is no client-credentials grant, so OAuth always involves a per-user consent step; each user signs in to their own Consensus account.
| | |
|---|---|
| **Authorization URL** | `https://consensus.app/oauth/authorize/` |
| **Token URL** | `https://consensus.app/oauth/token/` |
| **Dynamic Client Registration** | `https://consensus.app/oauth/register/` (RFC 7591) |
| **Scope** | `search`. Request `scope=search` or omit it; it’s the default. This is not an OIDC provider, so there are no `openid` or `email` scopes. |
| **PKCE** | Required. `S256` only; requests without a `code_challenge` are rejected. |
Keep the trailing slashes on the URLs.**Dynamic Client Registration issues public clients**: a `client_id` with no `client_secret`, which is why PKCE is required. If your gateway needs a confidential client (a `client_id` and `client_secret` pair) and can’t do DCR, Consensus provisions those manually for enterprise partners. [Contact sales](https://consensus.app/home/contact/sales/) and we’ll set one up.

| | Paid plans | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|
| Rate limit | 3 requests per second | Custom |
| Papers per call | Up to 300 (Pro, Teams) or 750 (Deep) | Up to 1,000 |
